name: mod
comment: Sig: r = mod(...). INTEGER input keeps the class: mod(int8(-7),int8(3))=2 int8 (floored), mod(int8([7 8 9]),int8(3))=[1 2 0] int8; a double operand is promoted to the integer class (mod(int8(7),3)=1 int8). Real-DOUBLE arrays (va = vector%vector, vsa = vector%scalar) take the SIMD path (a-floor(a/b)*b, bit-identical to the scalar formula). numkit previously returned double / threw on integer arrays; fixed 2026-05-30. SIMD mod added 2026-06. NOTE: ; only inside matrix-literal INPUTS.
